methodology.demerger: MARKET_VALUE_ADJUSTMENT: factor = exchange-derived adjusted base price / previous close, applied to the parent's pre-demerger prices. The tax cost-allocation ratio is separate tax metadata, never the price factor. The demerged company's shares are modelled separately for shareholder total return.
